Black holes are regions of spacetime where gravity is so strong that nothing can escape. They form when massive stars collapse at the end of their life cycle. The boundary of a black hole is called the event horizon. Stephen Hawking proposed that black holes emit thermal radiation. The first image of a black hole was captured in 2019 by the Event Horizon Telescope.
